steps.title: Two independent features
steps.body: Annotations and walks start independently. They share the workspace folder; **Submit Review** is where their output meets.
steps.quote:
activateAnnotations(context, folder)
  const walk = activateWalk(context, folder)

steps.title: Keep the code you were reading
steps.body: An annotation stores its file, range, and **snippet**. Later edits do not replace that snapshot. A thread can hold several annotations at the same location.

steps.title: One paste, with the context attached
steps.body: Copy each annotation with its path and snippet. Print the snippet only once per thread, so follow-up questions do not repeat the same code.

steps.title: An approval belongs to a specific proposal
steps.body: When the agent revises a walk, responses follow the step IDs. An approval survives only while the proposal is unchanged.
steps.quote: const approved = step?.proposal && entry.approved && unchanged(entry.approved, step) ? entry.approved : undefined
steps.details: The comparison includes the body, details, code quote, and diff. A new walk title starts a new review.
